        if is_valid:
            # Add p_new to the pre-allocated array and increment count.
            accepted_mat[count] = p_new
            count += 1
            
            # Early exit if we have already found a significantly large set.
            # This can save computation time in the evaluation environment.
            if count >= 600: # Aiming to beat 593.
                break

    # Return only the validly filled part of the pre-allocated array.
    return accepted_mat[:count]
